title: YourMondayMotivator: Do you need change?
html:
Last week I wrote that this was going to be an exciting week because I was moving my business home and another chapter was about to begin.

And then I had to actually move.

Getting everything home was simple. Finding a place for it ... not so simple.

So this mornings MondayMotivator is going to be very short because I am still moving things around and cleaning. Oh joy.

The thought struck me as I was thinking about what to write - Did I need change? Then I read this quote by Harold Wilson.

"He who rejects change is the architect of decay. The only human institution which rejects progress is the cemetery."

I'm certainly not in the cemetary yet and if you're reading this nor are you. Lets keep it that way and welcome change.

Have a great week.
Glenn
